karty.priklad: Ar adegau, mae'r gwaith yn anodd iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: At times the work is very hard.
karty.mnemo: The times you HAD EGGs (ADEG) – fried in a red-hot pan every morning.

extra.pozn: ar adegau = at times, sometimes; yr adeg honno = at that time; own example

karty.priklad: Mae addysg Gymraeg yn bwysig iawn yng Nghymru.
karty.priklad_cs: Welsh-medium education is very important in Wales (Cymraeg → [G]ymraeg after the feminine noun; Cymru → [Ngh]ymru after yng).
karty.mnemo: dysgu (to learn, to teach) is inside adDYSG: education – a shiny red apple on the teacher's desk.

extra.pozn: addysgu = to educate, to teach; addysg gorfforol = PE (arall L12); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r Eisteddfod yn dod i'r fro eleni.
karty.priklad_cs: The Eisteddfod is coming to our area this year (bro → [f]ro after 'r, feminine).
karty.mnemo: Your BRO (BRO) waits for you back home, by the red phone box in the village.

extra.pozn: papur bro = local Welsh-language community paper (p. 149); bro has an emotional ring – "home patch, homeland"; own example

karty.priklad: Maen nhw'n codi arian at ymchwil i ganser y fron.
karty.priklad_cs: They're raising money for breast cancer research (canser → [g]anser after i; bron → [f]ron after y, feminine).
karty.mnemo: A BRONze medal (BRON) pinned on your chest, glowing red-hot.

extra.pozn: careful, homonym: bron also means "almost, nearly" (bron yn barod); canser y fron = arall L12; sentence based on p. 149

sever.priklad: Maen nhw'n codi pres at ymchwil i ganser y fron.
sever.priklad_cs: They're raising money for breast cancer research (canser → [g]anser after i; bron → [f]ron after y, feminine).

karty.priklad: Bydd colled fawr ar ei ôl.
karty.priklad_cs: He'll be greatly missed (literally: there'll be a great loss after him; mawr → [f]awr after the feminine noun).
karty.mnemo: colli (to lose) → colled: a loss – the fire engine arrives too late.

extra.pozn: set phrase from the obituary in the papur bro, p. 149

karty.priklad: Paid â dweud wrth neb – mae'n gyfrinach!
karty.priklad_cs: Don't tell anyone – it's a secret! (cyfrinach → [g]yfrinach after 'n)
karty.mnemo: The secret is written in red lipstick and tucked up your CUFF (CYF-rinach).

extra.pozn: cyfrinachol = secret, confidential; in the book: Cadwyd y gyfrinach tan y diwrnod… (p. 149); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r blaid wedi colli llawer o seddi.
karty.priklad_cs: The party has lost a lot of seats (plaid → [b]laid after 'r, feminine).
karty.mnemo: Sounds like English PLAID (tartan): every party member in a red plaid scarf, red as a field of poppies.

extra.pozn: Plaid Cymru = the name of the Welsh party; pleidlais = vote, pleidleisio = to vote; own example

karty.priklad: Sawl tŷ teras sy yn y rhes?
karty.priklad_cs: How many terraced houses are there in the row?
karty.mnemo: A RACE (RHES): a row of runners in red vests on the starting line.

extra.pozn: feminine, but it doesn't mutate after y: ll- and rh- are the exception after the article (y rhes, y llaw); question from p. 151

karty.priklad: Mae'r driniaeth yn gweithio'n dda.
karty.priklad_cs: The treatment is working well (triniaeth → [d]riniaeth after 'r, feminine).
karty.mnemo: trin (to treat, to handle) + -iaeth: the treatment – a red heat lamp glowing on a sore back.

extra.pozn: trin = to treat, to handle (L13); in the book: ymchwil i driniaethau canser y fron (p. 149); own example

karty.priklad: Mae hi'n gwneud ymchwil i'r iaith Gymraeg.
karty.priklad_cs: She does research into the Welsh language (Cymraeg → [G]ymraeg after the feminine iaith).
karty.mnemo: ym- + chwilio (to search) = research: scientists testing the hottest red chillies.

extra.pozn: ymchwilio = to research, to investigate; ymchwilydd = researcher; own example

karty.priklad: Roedd Kyffin Williams yn arlunydd enwog.
karty.priklad_cs: Kyffin Williams was a famous artist.
karty.mnemo: darlun (picture) without the d- + -ydd (person): the one who paints pictures – icy blue glacier landscapes.

extra.rod_pozn: grammatically masculine even for a woman
extra.pozn: arlunio = to paint, to draw; artist (L7) is more general; own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r arolygydd yn dod i'r ysgol fory.
karty.priklad_cs: The inspector is coming to the school tomorrow.
karty.mnemo: arolwg (survey) + -ydd: the one who does the survey – an inspector with a frosty clipboard.

extra.rod_pozn: grammatically masculine even for a woman
extra.pozn: arolwg = survey, review (L16); arolygu = to inspect, to supervise; in the plural: Daeth yr arolygwyr i'r ysgol ddoe; own example

karty.priklad: Mae blas hyfryd ar y cawl.
karty.priklad_cs: The soup tastes lovely.
karty.mnemo: A BLAST (BLAS) of taste: the first suck of a blue slush puppy.

extra.pozn: pattern: mae blas … ar (something tastes …); blasu = to taste (L9), blasus = tasty; cael blas ar = arall L12; in the book: Ches i ddim blas o gwbl! (p. 153); own example

karty.priklad: Mae hi'n codi arian at ymchwil i ganser.
karty.priklad_cs: She's raising money for cancer research (canser → [g]anser after i).
karty.mnemo: From English cancer: a cold, blue-lit hospital ward.

extra.pozn: sentence based on p. 149

sever.priklad: Mae hi'n codi pres at ymchwil i ganser.
sever.priklad_cs: She's raising money for cancer research (canser → [g]anser after i).

karty.priklad: Ffeindion nhw gorff yn y llyn.
karty.priklad_cs: They found a body in the lake (corff → [g]orff as the object).
karty.mnemo: Latin corpus → CORFF: a body frozen inside a blue glacier.

extra.pozn: formal news form: Daethpwyd o hyd i gorff (p. 147); corfforol = physical (L13); corff also means a body, an institution (corff cyhoeddus); own example

karty.priklad: Cawson nhw eu carcharu am gyfanswm o ugain mlynedd.
karty.priklad_cs: They were jailed for a total of twenty years (cyfanswm → [g]yfanswm after am; blynedd → [m]lynedd after ugain).
karty.mnemo: cyfan (whole) + swm (sum): the whole sum on a receipt stuck to the freezer door.

extra.pozn: sentence based on the exercise on p. 147 (Carcharwyd pump o bobl … am gyfanswm o ugain mlynedd)

karty.priklad: Cynulliad Cenedlaethol Cymru oedd hen enw'r Senedd.
karty.priklad_cs: The National Assembly for Wales was the old name of the Senedd.
karty.mnemo: cynnull = to gather: an assembly is a gathering – in a cold, echoing hall.

extra.pozn: the Welsh parliament was called Cynulliad Cenedlaethol Cymru until 2020; cynulleidfa = audience (L6), same root "to gather"; the book gives no plural; own example

karty.priklad: Mae darlun hyfryd o'r môr ar y wal.
karty.priklad_cs: There's a lovely picture of the sea on the wall.
karty.mnemo: dar + LUN ~ llun (picture): a picture of a polar bear on an ice floe.

extra.pozn: darlunio = to illustrate, to draw; own example

karty.priklad: Achosodd y storm lawer o ddifrod.
karty.priklad_cs: The storm caused a lot of damage (llawer → [l]awer as the object; difrod → [dd]ifrod after o).
karty.mnemo: A DIVER (DI-FROD) finds damage to the hull under the ice.

extra.pozn: difrodi = to damage; achosi = to cause (L5); own example

karty.priklad: Dw i'n hoffi dysgu am ddiwylliant Cymru.
karty.priklad_cs: I like learning about Welsh culture (diwylliant → [dd]iwylliant after am).
karty.mnemo: A memory aid: di- + gwyllt (wild) = no longer wild, cultivated – a neat formal garden under blue frost.

extra.pozn: diwylliannol = cultural; own example

karty.priklad: Does dim llawer o ddodrefn yn y fflat.
karty.priklad_cs: There isn't much furniture in the flat (dodrefn → [dd]odrefn after o).
karty.mnemo: "DO DRESS" the igloo (DODREFN): furnish it with frosty blue furniture.

extra.pozn: collective plural: dodrefn = furniture (the more common form), dodrefnyn = one piece; dodrefnu = to furnish; own example

karty.priklad: Cafodd y llanc ei garcharu am ddwy flynedd.
karty.priklad_cs: The lad was jailed for two years (carcharu → [g]archaru after ei = his; blynedd → [f]lynedd after dwy).
karty.mnemo: A LANKY (LLANC) lad in a blue hoodie.

extra.pozn: llances = girl, young woman; sentence from the exercise on p. 148

karty.priklad: Dyma'r man lle cwrddon ni gynta.
karty.priklad_cs: This is the place where we first met.
karty.mnemo: X marks the spot where the snowMAN stands.

extra.rod_pozn: masculine according to the coursebook; in the set phrase yn y fan a'r lle it mutates like a feminine noun (y fan)
extra.pozn: unman = nowhere, anywhere; yn y fan a'r lle = on the spot, immediately; in the book: mewn rhai mannau = in some places (p. 150); don't confuse with fan (f) = van; own example

sever.priklad: Dyma'r man lle wnaethon ni gyfarfod gynta.
sever.priklad_cs: This is the place where we first met (cyfarfod → [g]yfarfod after wnaethon ni).
sever.pozn: north: cyfarfod instead of cwrdd (outside the coursebook), past tense with gwneud

karty.priklad: Mae Merched y Wawr yn fudiad i fenywod yng Nghymru.
karty.priklad_cs: Merched y Wawr is an organisation for women in Wales (mudiad → [f]udiad after yn; menywod → [f]enywod after i; Cymru → [Ngh]ymru after yng).
karty.mnemo: symud = to move: mudiad = a movement, marching across a frozen square.

extra.pozn: mudo = to move house, same root "movement"; Merched y Wawr and Llywydd Cenedlaethol y Mudiad: p. 149; own example

karty.priklad: Anfonwn ni becyn arall atoch chi.
karty.priklad_cs: We'll send another packet to you (pecyn → [b]ecyn as the object after the short verb form).
karty.mnemo: From English packet: a packet of frozen fish fingers.

extra.pozn: sentence from the dialogue on p. 153

karty.priklad: Bydd y tai newydd ar safle'r hen ffatri.
karty.priklad_cs: The new houses will be on the site of the old factory.
karty.mnemo: saf- (sefyll, to stand) + lle (place): the place where something stands – a penguin standing on its own spot.

extra.pozn: also a position in a league table (safle cynta) and a website (safle we); own example

karty.priklad: Mae hi'n gweithio i sefydliad mawr yng Nghaerdydd.
karty.priklad_cs: She works for a big institution in Cardiff (Caerdydd → [Ngh]aerdydd after yng).
karty.mnemo: sefydlu = to establish: an institution, built solid as a glacier.

extra.pozn: sefydlu = to establish, to found; sefydlog = stable, settled; Sefydliad y Gweithwyr = workmen's institute (St Fagans, p. 151); own example

karty.priklad: Bydd y tymheredd yn codi dros y penwythnos.
karty.priklad_cs: Temperatures will rise over the weekend.
karty.mnemo: TYMHER ~ English TEMPERature: a thermometer frozen at minus twenty in the Arctic.

extra.pozn: sentence based on the weather forecast in Bwletin Newyddion (p. 150), where the word is a gap to fill

karty.priklad: Bydd hi'n anodd ei gweld hi yn y tywyllwch.
karty.priklad_cs: It'll be hard to see her in the dark (gweld doesn't change after ei = her).
karty.mnemo: tywyll (dark) + -wch: the long darkness of an Arctic winter night.

extra.pozn: sentence from the papur bro, p. 149

karty.priklad: Aeth y wobr am yr unigolyn gorau i'r seiclwr Tomos Griffiths.
karty.priklad_cs: The prize for the best individual went to the cyclist Tomos Griffiths (gwobr → [w]obr after y, feminine).
karty.mnemo: un (one) + unig (only, alone) → unigolyn: one lone walrus on an ice floe.

extra.rod_pozn: grammatically masculine even for a woman
extra.pozn: unig = only, lonely; unigol = individual, single; sentence from Bwletin Newyddion, p. 150
